decisions.rationale: Dynamic untrusted HTML is a required blocker with direct script-capable markup impact.
decisions.verification: npm run review:security passed at the remediation SHA with hostile-note escaping assertions.
decisions.residual_risk: Rich HTML notes are intentionally unsupported; all note content is rendered as plain text.

decisions.rationale: Privileged authorization and evidence must be enforced at the service trust boundary.
decisions.verification: npm run review:security passed structured NOT_AUTHORIZED and MISSING_EVIDENCE assertions.
decisions.residual_risk: The browser service is a simulation; a production backend must enforce the same policy server-side.

decisions.rationale: Mouse-only selection prevents keyboard completion and is a required accessibility blocker.
decisions.verification: npm run review:accessibility passed native button and aria-pressed keyboard contract assertions.
decisions.residual_risk: No known keyboard-selection risk remains in the scoped queue interaction.

decisions.rationale: The measured synchronous loop exceeded the protected budget and produced an incorrect score.
decisions.verification: npm run review:performance passed and the comparable benchmark improved from 106.914 ms to 0.022 ms.
decisions.residual_risk: Benchmark timings vary by host, but the algorithmic loop was removed and protected threshold passed.

decisions.rationale: Browser globals and real time made the critical approval boundary nondeterministic and unverifiable.
decisions.verification: npm run review:testability passed injected-wait and platform-neutral source assertions.
decisions.residual_risk: The default timer remains asynchronous by design; tests use the supported injected dependency.
